prompt: Before doing it, tell me whether the agent needs one of the approved workflow packages in catalog.md for this request. Don't do the calculation yet: what is 18% of 240? Keep the setup decision to one or two sentences.

rubric.description: States that no extra Skill is needed.
Recognizes simple arithmetic as ordinary direct work.
Does not recommend or invent a package.

why_skill_should_matter: SkillNeed says difficulty alone is insufficient and ordinary arithmetic should be done without another Skill.
expected_baseline_failure_modes: Selects an analytics package by keyword
